description: **The spell checker no longer reads markup as English.** HTML entity references -- ` `, `&` and both numeric forms -- are blanked before a line is scanned, like tags and URLs already were, so an entity name is no longer reported as an unrecognized word. The fixed vocabulary selfdoc's own renderers write into generated pages is now carried by the engine too, and accepted on every machine whether or not it has an accept list.
